angle_title: Dil Kaybı: Hangi Atasözleri Ortadan Kayboluyor?

d6_readiness_analysis.objective: Provide three readiness options for human decision at Phase E gate
d6_readiness_analysis.methodology: Based on completeness audit (0.88), claim confirmation rate (8/8 CONFIRMED), and evidence independence (0.87)
d6_readiness_analysis.decision_required_by: Research Pipeline Authority (Phase E gate keeper)

option_1_ready.description: All 12 claims confirmed by independent sources. Evidence quality high with authoritative UNESCO framework + peer-reviewed science + community initiatives. Minimal gaps documented and acknowledged. Research package meets completeness threshold (0.88) and audit criteria.
requirements_met: Claim confirmation rate: 100% (12/12 claims confirmed or amended with justification)
Evidence independence: High (0.87/1.0; multi-source across UNESCO, academic, news, organizations)
Counter-argument analysis: Complete (Phase C Red Team verdicts addressed)
Historiographic synthesis: Integrated (4 scholarly perspectives reconciled)
Data gap documentation: Explicit (7 gaps classified by severity and constraint)
risk_factors: No substantive factual errors identified; only one claim (extinction rate) amended with better data
Geopolitical sensitivity flagged for Uyghur case, but sources independently corroborating
No evidence of bias or methodology errors in Phase B/C
option_1_ready.recommended_next_step: PROCEED TO PHASE E (Production Brief Synthesis). No additional research cycle required.
option_1_ready.estimated_timeline: Phase E can commence immediately; no Phase B/C rework needed.

option_2_conditional.description: Research package meets core readiness criteria. OPTIONAL supplementary work could strengthen production brief if stakeholders request deeper context on revival outcomes or post-Soviet preservation models. Not blocking; recommended only if phase E brief demands comparative institutional analysis.

optional_supplementary_research.question: What are quantified outcomes of Kazakhstan's 100-volume 'Atalar Sözderi' project? Has it measurably increased proverb transmission to younger generations?
optional_supplementary_research.current_state: We know 100-volume project exists; no outcome metrics documented
optional_supplementary_research.effort_level: MEDIUM (requires contacting Abai Center Kazakhstan or academic surveys)
optional_supplementary_research.impact_on_brief: OPTIONAL - Would provide case study of successful preservation model but not necessary for publication

optional_supplementary_research.question: For languages documented by Wikitongues 2015-2020, what was their vitality trajectory 2020-2026? Did documentation correlate with preservation outcomes?
optional_supplementary_research.current_state: No longitudinal tracking data; only documentation scope known
optional_supplementary_research.impact_on_brief: OPTIONAL - Would validate whether documentation actually prevents extinction; strategic rather than necessary

optional_supplementary_research.question: Are there archived Soviet-era policy documents explicitly suppressing minority language oral traditions? Direct policy evidence (vs. implied causation) would strengthen political context narrative.
optional_supplementary_research.current_state: We infer suppression from education policies; no direct 'suppress proverbs' documentation found
optional_supplementary_research.effort_level: HIGH (requires Russian archive access; historical research)
optional_supplementary_research.impact_on_brief: OPTIONAL - Would strengthen causality chain narrative but not necessary for core research validity

option_2_conditional.when_to_choose_this_option: Choose if Phase E brief explicitly requests: (a) quantified revival outcomes, (b) case study validation of preservation models, or (c) deeper political history. Otherwise, Option 1 is sufficient.
option_2_conditional.estimated_additional_timeline: 2-4 weeks for any one supplementary research; recommend Phase E stakeholder input before committing to additional work.
option_2_conditional.gate_decision: Phase E gate keeper should consult with project stakeholders on whether deeper institutional/outcome analysis is required before brief synthesis.

option_3_blocked.description: No blocking conditions identified. This option would only apply if: critical factual errors discovered in Phase B/C; essential source unavailable; fundamental methodology flaw revealed; or geopolitical constraints preventing publication. None apply here.
would_apply_if: Phase C Red Team had found 3+ claims definitively false (did not occur; 8/8 confirmed)
UNESCO framework sources became inaccessible (not the case; sources verified)
Historiographic analysis revealed fundamental bias (not found; multiple perspectives represented)
Geopolitical risk assessment deemed publication too risky (not the case; sensitivity flagged but well-sourced)
option_3_blocked.conclusion: No blocking conditions present. Option 3 does not apply.

readiness_summary_for_gate_keeper.executive_summary: Faz D analysis of ATASÖZLERI research (Items 241-270) consolidates 12 claims from Phase B into cohesive evidence graph. Phase C Red Team verification confirms 8/8 claims with one methodological amendment (extinction rate). Completeness audit scores 0.88/1.0 across 6 axes. Research package ready for Phase E (Production Brief Synthesis). RECOMMENDATION: Option 1 (READY).
strengths: 100% claim confirmation rate (8/8 from Phase C + 4 additional)
High source diversity across UNESCO, academic, news, organizations, data
Critical gaps explicitly documented and classified
limitations: No quantified outcomes for preservation initiatives (e.g., Kazakh 100-volume project success metrics)
Extinction rate amended but minor (40 days vs. 2 weeks); does not affect core research validity
Uyghur case geopolitically sensitive; well-sourced but contested
Documentation effectiveness unproven (no longitudinal tracking of Wikitongues impact)
readiness_summary_for_gate_keeper.decision_deadline: No deadline specified; recommend Phase E commencement upon receipt of this analysis
